name: VEE-SR GTP

specs.notes: An LMDh prototype on a Dallara LMP2 tub: the naturally aspirated LMC55R 5.5 V8 with the series' 50 kW Bosch motor at the rear, the pair held to 500 kW (680 PS) by the rules; 1,030 kg minimum; Xtrac P1359 7-speed sequential; 3,148 mm wheelbase, 4,990 x 1,996 mm; Michelin 29/71-18 front, 34/71-18 rear (Wikipedia, Wayne Taylor Racing's spec sheet). Torque isn't published (from the power, a high-revving NA curve); the power peak's rpm (7,600), the limiter, ~340 km/h (Le Mans trim), the ratios, weight distribution and aero (the prototype chassis' downforce) are estimates.

garage.blurb: A Le Mans prototype with a naturally aspirated V8 that howls to 8,500: barely a tonne, wings everywhere, and more grip than anything else here once it's going fast.

interior.notes: The model's carbon tub: its racing wheel cut out by part, the seat found by the probe; paddles: the hands stay on the wheel.

source.license: CGTrader Royalty Free License (seller CGI-FORGE, best match)

limitations: Torque, the power peak's rpm, top speed, the ratios, weight distribution and aero are estimates.
Provenance: parts named like a racing-sim mod (ORECA_03 calipers, STEER_HR, a 963 LED material); fine among friends, replace before any public release.
The game's livery replaces its race livery (its body is the game's paint).
